counterfactual_fixtures.purpose: Adds two home lines to one order, distinguishing distinct orders from line count.
Adds a pending home order that must not enter the population.

reference_implementation_a.sql: SELECT c.customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS home_orders FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND p.category = 'home' GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY c.customer_id

reference_implementation_b.sql: WITH home_orders AS (SELECT DISTINCT o.customer_id, o.order_id FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND p.category = 'home') SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS home_orders FROM home_orders GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY customer_id
